memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gout
  - Status: No recent flare, serum uric acid pending.
  - Plan: Start allopurinol 100 mg OD after breakfast; advise low‑purine diet.
- COPD
  - Status: Dyspnea on mild exertion, using salbutamol SOS.
  - Plan: Initiate tiotropium inhaler OD morning; budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD after meals; ensure inhaler technique.
- General
  - Weight: 62 kg; Waist: 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm, elevated).
  - Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast, egg white; Lunch – dal, vegetables, small rice; Dinner – light soup, salad.
  - Review in 3 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had mild pain and swelling in my left big toe for two days, worse after walking. No fever. I took one colchicine tablet this morning.
